The '''Sky Ridge Loch''' was a lake located on the [[Sky Ridge Island]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sky Ridge Loch appears as an area on Rishi in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />
